column2: Authentication
Test sign up login and password reset functionalities including negative cases and validations
Passed
Test Case Description
Verify successful Sign up with valid data
column3:
1. Open Mobile App.
2. Tap 'Đăng ký'.
3. Enter valid Name, new Email, Phone, Password.
4. Tap 'Đăng ký'.
5. Enter valid OTP.
column4:
Account is created successfully.
Toast message: 'Đăng ký thành công'. User redirected to Main screen.
column5: New valid email and phone number.

column2: Verify Sign up with already registered email
column3:
1. Enter an email that is already in the system.
2. Fill other details and submit.
column4:
Submission fails.
Validation error: 'Email đã được sử dụng'.

column2: Verify Sign up with weak password
column3:
1. Enter a password less than 8 characters.
2. Submit form.
column4:
Submission blocked.
Validation error: 'Mật khẩu phải có ít nhất 8 ký tự'.

column2: Verify Sign up with mismatched confirm password
column3:
1. Enter password and a different confirm password.
2. Submit form.
column4:
Submission blocked.
Validation error: 'Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp'.

column2: Verify Sign up OTP validation against wrong OTP
column3:
1. Submit valid sign up form.
2. In OTP screen, enter an incorrect OTP.
3. Submit.
column4:
Error message: 'Mã OTP không chính xác'.
User remains on OTP screen.

column2: Verify successful Login (Web/Mobile)
column3:
1. Enter valid Email and Password.
2. Click/Tap 'Đăng nhập'.
column4:
Login successful. Redirected to Dashboard/Home.
Toast message: 'Đăng nhập thành công'.

column2: Verify Login with wrong password
column3:
1. Enter valid Email but incorrect Password.
2. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
column4:
Login blocked.
Error message: 'Email hoặc mật khẩu không chính xác'.

column2: Verify Login with non-existent email
column3:
1. Enter an unregistered email address.
2. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
column4:
Login blocked.
Error message: 'Tài khoản không tồn tại'.

column2: Verify Login form validation (empty fields)
column3:
1. Leave Email and Password empty.
2. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
column4:
Login blocked.
Validation text under fields: 'Vui lòng nhập Email' and 'Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu'.

column2: Verify successful Login by Google
column3:
1. Click 'Đăng nhập bằng Google'.
2. Select an active Google account.
column4:
Login successful.
Toast message: 'Đăng nhập thành công'.

column2: Verify cancelling Login by Google popup
column3:
1. Click 'Đăng nhập bằng Google'.
2. Close the Google popup without selecting an account.
column4: User remains on Login screen without errors.

column2: Verify successful Logout
column3:
1. Click on User Profile/Avatar.
2. Click 'Đăng xuất'.
column4:
Redirected to Login screen.
Toast message: 'Đăng xuất thành công'. Session Token is cleared.

column2: Verify Forgot Password sends OTP to valid email
column3:
1. Click 'Quên mật khẩu'.
2. Enter registered Email.
3. Click 'Gửi OTP'.
column4:
OTP is sent.
Toast message: 'Mã OTP đã được gửi'. Redirected to OTP entry screen.

column2: Verify Forgot Password with unregistered email
column3:
1. Click 'Quên mật khẩu'.
2. Enter an unregistered Email.
3. Click 'Gửi OTP'.
column4: Error message: 'Tài khoản không hợp lệ hoặc không tồn tại'.

column2: Verify Reset Password with valid OTP
column3:
1. Enter valid OTP received from email.
2. Enter new Password twice.
3. Click 'Đặt lại mật khẩu'.
column4:
Password updated.
Toast message: 'Đặt lại mật khẩu thành công'. Redirected to Login.

column2: Verify Reset Password with invalid/expired OTP
column3:
1. Enter an incorrect or expired OTP.
2. Fill new passwords and submit.
column4:
Action blocked.
Error message: 'Mã OTP không chính xác hoặc đã hết hạn'.
